name: gemma-4-26b
about: Google Gemma 4, mixture of experts (26B, 4B active), BF16 as released. Apache-2.0. NOT USABLE with the POC as of 2026-09: under strict JSON output it collapses into repeating a token mid-answer, a known model-level regression from Gemma 3 (google-deepmind/gemma#622, vllm-project/vllm#40080) that penalties do not fix. Tried here: default settings, no-whitespace grammar, Google's recommended sampling, and FLEX_ATTENTION (would not start); short prompts answer correctly, benchmark prompts loop. See results/superseded and results/quick.
